title: Climate-Gated Nitrogen Export: code and data (Iowa counties, 2001-2019)
description: Reproducibility archive for Soetan & Kaleita, 'Climate-Gated Nitrogen Export: Hydroclimatic Timing Improves the Efficiency of Nitrogen-Surplus Reductions in Iowa.' Includes the county-year panel, county-month load products, data-construction and analysis notebooks, and confirmatory-analysis code. Regenerates figures, tables, and statistics from publicly available USGS, USDA NASS, IEM, and IFEWS inputs.
